_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: the Kierkegaard of David F. Swenson (1876-1940; with Lillian Marvin Swenson, who finished his work) and Walter Lowrie (1868-1959), the English Kierkegaard of 1936-1955. Added 2026-11-03 (Adam: "I want all of Swenson and Lowry translations connected and scheduled for release"). Every volume is listed here once: open ones under `internet_archive` (fetched) or `_pending` (open in law, no free text yet), the rest under `_waiting` with the day each opens, and each waiting one is on the house release queue (wordhoard apps/thewordhoard/data/release-queue.json, ledger = this file). Renewals searched 2026-11-03 in the Stanford Copyright Renewal Database and in the printed Catalog of Copyright Entries (registrations 1936-1947; renewals 1963-64, 1970-71, 1973-74) on the Internet Archive: wordhoard docs/research/2026-11-03-kierkegaard-swenson-lowrie.md. Hollander's 1923 Selections is on the hollander shelf. No uids minted.

_waiting._note_oup: Four Lowrie volumes came out first in London (Oxford University Press, 1939-41), were never registered in the US and never renewed. The URAA of 1996 restores a foreign-published book only when an author was a national or domiciliary of another treaty country (17 USC 104A(h)(6)(C)). Lowrie was an American living in Princeton, so they look restorable only through a co-author, and these four have none: on that reading they are US public domain now. They are held to their 95-year days until Adam rules (the house's rule for a book that may be free already: wordhoard ADR 0041). Training in Christianity's verso confirms the London-first publication; the other three are read from their catalogue records.

_excluded.lowrie-kierkegaard-biography-1938: Lowrie's own Kierkegaard (Oxford, 1938) and A Short Life of Kierkegaard (Princeton, 1942, renewed R482953), and Swenson's Something about Kierkegaard (Augsburg, 1941, renewed R447260): books about Kierkegaard, not translations. Not on this shelf; Adam may ask for them.
